motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Council request the Department of Recreation and Parks to report on existing protocols, policies and requirements governing the use of parks and recreational facilities for private events that charge admission or other fees to members of the public. I FURTHER MOVE that the City Council request the Department of Recreation and Parks to update all related protocols for private use of public spaces with an opportunity for formal public review. PRESENTED BY: SECONDED BY: UVLRVCA MONICA RODRIGUEZ ( Councilwoman, 7th District — W —— AUG 0 4 2026
title: Use of Parks / Recreational Facilities / Private Events / Admission Charge / Protocols and Policies

requests.asks: Report on existing protocols, policies and requirements governing the use of parks and recreational facilities for private events that charge admission or other fees to members of the public
